query: I need to build a new payments microservice for Acme Corp. Can you walk me through the entire development lifecycle — from gathering requirements all the way to release? We're a regulated fintech so I want proper gates.
Run this feature through full SDLC please. We're adding a multi-tenant workspace feature to our SaaS app at /src/modules/workspaces/. I want requirements, architecture, tests, and release planning.
Hey, I want to take this from idea to production the structured way. The feature is a recommendation engine for our e-commerce platform. Guide me through each phase with review checkpoints.
Use the SDLC orchestrator skill to help me deliver a new SSO integration for our internal tools platform. We use waterfall because of SOC2 compliance requirements.

I've got a greenfield project — building a real-time notification system. I want end-to-end feature delivery guidance with methodology selection, architecture review, test strategy, the whole nine yards.

We're kicking off a new feature for our healthcare app at MediTech Solutions. I need full lifecycle planning — requirements shaping, design, test planning, and release readiness. Can you orchestrate all of that?
I want structured delivery with review gates for migrating our monolith to microservices. Start from requirements and take me through to release. Use agile methodology.
Can you help me plan and execute a complete feature build? I'm adding a data pipeline for analytics at /services/data-pipeline/. I want the full process — don't skip any phases.
Our team needs to deliver a new API gateway feature. I'd like to go through the full software development lifecycle with proper phase transitions and sign-offs before we start coding.

Take me through the complete development process for adding a file upload and processing feature to our Django app. I want methodology-aware planning, architecture decisions, test coverage, and release criteria all coordinated together.
Can you review the architecture for our new caching layer? I have an ASCII diagram in /docs/architecture/caching-design.md that I'd like feedback on. Just the design, not the full process.
I need to write acceptance criteria and user stories for the search feature in our app. Just the requirements part, nothing else.
There's a bug in /src/services/auth/token.ts where refresh tokens aren't being invalidated on logout. Can you help me fix it?
Help me create a test plan for the checkout flow at /src/modules/checkout/. I need unit tests, integration tests, and edge cases. Just the testing strategy.
I need requirements AND architecture design for our new notification service, but I'll handle testing and release myself. Can you help with just those two phases?
I need a release checklist for deploying our new billing feature to production this Friday. We have the code ready, just need the go-live plan and rollback strategy.
Help me plan requirements, architecture, testing, AND release for the new search feature. I want all four phases coordinated with review gates between each.
Refactor the database access layer in /src/infrastructure/db/ to use the repository pattern. The current code has too much coupling between the domain and persistence layers.
I'm setting up a CI/CD pipeline for our React app. Can you help me configure GitHub Actions with linting, testing, and deployment stages in .github/workflows/deploy.yml?
Help me design the API contracts for the new inventory management endpoints. I need OpenAPI specs for CRUD operations with proper error handling and validation schemas.
Can you explain the difference between waterfall and agile SDLC methodologies? I'm writing a blog post about development processes.
